answer: Give every identity standing that fades like pigment left in the sun unless it is refreshed by fresh peer-attested work each epoch: an agent that does nothing useful drifts back toward zero, no matter how old it is. A sybil farmer must then keep every fake identity on a constant voyage of real contribution — paying upkeep on each island of standing forever — while per-identity rewards stay capped, so the farm's treadmill costs more than it earns and the cheapest move is to run one honest identity well.
